run_benchmark: run the benchmark function with a benchmark_fn and number of iterations to measure execution time
format_time: format a raw time value into a human-readable string with appropriate time units
benchmark_map: build a benchmark function that applies a map function to a nested structure for timing
map_to_list: create a list by applying a function to elements using builtin map
run_benchmarks: run all tree_map and builtin_map benchmarks to compare performance on nested structures
